statBlock.name: Abyssal Wretch
statBlock.description: Creatures warped by a rutterkin’s bite can rise as abyssal wretches and follow the mob that made them.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Adult Kruthik
statBlock.description: Adult kruthiks carve tunnels through stone. They rush prey as a pack and fire spikes when it stays out of reach.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The kruthik makes Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell with advantage.
Pack Tactics. It has advantage on an attack roll if at least one ally is within 5 ft. of its target and that ally isn’t incapacitated.
Tunneler. It can dig through solid rock at half its burrow speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Stab attacks or two Spike attacks.
Stab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Adult Oblex
statBlock.description: An oblex steals memories and sends out convincing doubles of its victims. A faint sulfur smell can give a double away.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. The oblex is blind beyond that range.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion and prone.
sections.Other skill proficiency: Give the oblex one of Arcana +7, History +7, Nature +7 or Religion +7.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The oblex can pass through openings 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. Taking fire damage gives it disadvantage on attacks and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The oblex casts with Intelligence (spell save DC 15) and needs no components.
3/day each. Charm Person at 5th level, Color Spray, Detect Thoughts and Hold Person at 3rd level.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Pseudopod attack and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Constructs, oozes, plants and undead automatically succeed. On a failure, the target takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or benefits from Greater Restoration or Heal. While drained, it subtracts 1d4 from every attack roll and ability check. Each further instance of memory drain increases the die by one step, from d4 to d6 to d8 and so on. When the die reaches d20, the creature falls unconscious for 1 hour and the effect ends after that hour. Whenever the oblex drains a creature, it learns that creature’s languages and gains its proficiencies except saving throw proficiencies.
sections.Bonus actions: Sulfurous Impersonation. Extrude a double of a Medium or smaller creature whose memories the oblex has stolen. It looks, feels and sounds like the original, with a faint smell of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 creatures at a time. Each double shares the oblex’s body and occupies its own space alongside the main body. A slime tether reaches up to 120 ft. from the main body to each double. Damage cannot break the tether. If no path with at least 1 inch of clearance connects the two, the tether breaks and the double disappears.

statBlock.name: Air Elemental Myrmidon
statBlock.description: This air elemental is bound into a suit of plate armor. It has lost its memories of freedom and serves its creator.

sections.Languages: Auran and one language its creator chooses.
sections.Damage resistances: Lightning and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Weapons. The myrmidon’s weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Lightning Strike (Recharge 6). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, also deal 18 (4d8) lightning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be stunned through the end of the myrmidon’s next turn.

statBlock.name: Alkilith
statBlock.description: A motionless alkilith looks like fungus growing around a window or doorway. Given time, it can turn that opening into a portal to the Abyss.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The alkilith can pass through gaps 1 inch wide without squeezing.
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for ordinary slime or fungus.
Foment Madness. A creature other than a demon that starts its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, buzzing in its head gives it disadvantage on its next attack roll, saving throw or ability check, whichever comes first. If it fails by 5 or more, it is affected by Confusion for 1 minute instead. This effect requires no concentration. The creature is immune to Foment Madness while that Confusion lasts.
Magic Resistance. The alkilith has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) acid damage.

statBlock.name: Allip
statBlock.description: An allip is the ghostly remnant of someone destroyed by a forbidden secret. It tries to pass fragments of that knowledge to others.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone and restrained.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The allip treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Undead Nature. The allip needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Maddening Touch. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage.
Whispers of Madness. Choose up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 7 (1d8 + 3) psychic damage and must spend its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against a creature the allip chooses and can see. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.
Howling Babble (Recharge 6). Every creature within 30 ft. that hears the allip makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids the stun. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.
sections.Insidious Lore: Over days or weeks, an allip can coax a scholar into recording the secret that cursed it. If the scholar records the secret, the allip can pass into the afterlife. The record can claim another victim.
